statusDefinitions.pending: No reviewer has established how this occurrence should be represented.
statusDefinitions.accepted: The reviewer confirmed that the source-faithful occurrence is intentional and that no unsupported executable meaning is claimed.
statusDefinitions.corrected: The reviewer confirmed a source or typed-field defect and linked its tested correction.
statusDefinitions.false-positive: The reviewer confirmed that the detector matched valid source content rather than a corpus defect.

reviewChecks.note: The registered anomaly detector is a required CI gate; all remaining hits must be explicitly reviewed in extraction-overrides.json.
The graph gate expands every entity type, manifest, and bundle and rejects data loss or bare IRI-coerced strings.
Only the local SRD source contributes retained assertions; the obsolete external creature cache has been removed.
The fidelity gate rejects empty tables, promoted repeated headers, and source-span mismatches.
The fidelity gate compares advertised spell, ability, magic-item, equipment, and attack fields with their local source spans.
